# Fortis Healthcare unit expands in India with Suguna Hospital buy
**The 110-bed facility is located on Dr Rajkumar Road.**

[Fortis Healthcare](https://healthcareasiamagazine.com/healthcare/news/ihh-cooperate-fortis-audit-stands-its-31-stake-purchase)’s subsidiary International Hospital Limited (IHL) has acquired Suguna Hospital in Bengaluru, India, from Suguna Ramaiah Hospitals Private Limited by way of a slump sale.

As part of the transaction, IHL will acquire the entire business operations of Suguna Hospital, along with the underlying hospital land and building.

Revenue for the quarter rose 24% to RM737.44 million from RM593.13 million, driven by sustained patient demand and higher hospital utilisation across the group's hospitals, as well as increased contributions from Sunway Medical Centre (SMC) Ipoh, Damansara, Velocity and Penang.

Sunway Healthcare will continue to progressively license and operationalise its remaining capacity, particularly at Sunway Medical Centre (SMC) Sunway City’s Tower F, SMC Damansara and SMC Ipoh, its president Datuk Lau Beng Long said in a statement.
